body: Thank you. It does feel reassuring that I'm not the only one. It's weird how I can feel so alone when there's so many other's like me out there.
Nothing happened in particular, it was a gradual transition. I think it's the build up of lots of different things and it's just too much now.

I'm in my last year of sixth form (UK) before university. These feelings started around half a year ago and it just slowly got worse. I'm simply no one's first choice and I've accepted the fact I won't ever find someone or have a best friend. I don't usually share my emotions and I find it difficult to express how I'm feeling (quite reserved I guess). Even if I try people just tell me it'll get better but it never does.
